decisions.reason: The adapter was launched very visibly on the homepage and fits the firm's core lighting-track business, so sunk development and public commitment make management more likely to continue with it unless failure is unmistakable.
An LED luminaire is close to the core business of a German electrical equipment maker, and even with limited later evidence management would tend to justify the 2018 launch and keep it on the market.

The home automation server box appears less central to the firm's established product logic and was not highlighted as strongly, so despite some commitment it is the easiest product for management to discontinue by 2022.
A luminaire family had its own page, implying a broader and more visible commitment in a core category, which under escalation of commitment strongly favors retaining it.
